name: Exp_Kolier_SuperTrend
summary: This EA trades based on the Kolier SuperTrend indicator, opening buy positions on upward trend signals and sell positions on downward trend signals. It uses ATR-based trend detection with configurable multiplier and period, and applies fixed Stop Loss/Take Profit levels for trade management. The EA only enters new trades on new bar formations to avoid excessive trading on tick noise.
summary_zh: 该EA基于Kolier SuperTrend指标进行交易，在上升趋势信号时开多仓，在下降趋势信号时开空仓。它使用基于ATR的趋势检测，具有可配置的乘数和周期，并采用固定的止损/止盈水平进行交易管理。EA仅在新K线形成时才进行新的交易，以避免在tick噪声下过度交易。
strategy_analysis: 该EA采用Kolier SuperTrend指标作为核心策略，该指标基于ATR（平均真实波幅）乘以一个系数来动态调整趋势线。入场条件为：当指标的上行信号线触发时（UpSignal为真），允许开多仓并同时平空仓；当指标的下行信号线触发时（DnSignal为真），允许开空仓并同时平多仓。出场条件包括：反向信号触发时平仓、固定止损（默认1000点）和固定止盈（默认2000点）。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值表示固定手数，正值表示按存款比例计算手数。资金管理依赖外部TradeAlgorithms.mqh库函数，支持止损止盈和价格偏离控制。策略仅在每根新K线形成时检测信号，避免重复交易，同时使用Recount机制在数据不足时重新计算。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses the Kolier SuperTrend indicator as its core strategy, which dynamically adjusts the trend line based on ATR (Average True Range) multiplied by a configurable coefficient. Entry conditions are: when the indicator's upward signal line triggers (UpSignal is true), it allows opening long positions and simultaneously closing short positions; when the downward signal line triggers (DnSignal is true), it allows opening short positions and simultaneously closing long positions. Exit conditions include: closing on reverse signals, fixed Stop Loss (default 1000 points), and fixed Take Profit (default 2000 points). Position sizing is controlled via the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent deposit-proportional sizing. Money management relies on the external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions, supporting stop loss/take profit and price deviation control. The strategy only checks signals on each new bar formation to avoid repeated trades, and uses a Recount mechanism to recalculate when data is insufficient.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 存款份额或手数，负值为固定手数
parameters.description_en: Deposit fraction or lot size; negative value = fixed lots

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线索引

pros: 基于SuperTrend的趋势跟踪策略逻辑清晰，适合趋势行情
使用新K线检测机制避免tick级别重复交易，减少过度交易风险
提供独立的买卖开仓和平仓权限控制，灵活性高
具有Recount容错机制，在数据不足时自动重试
固定止损止盈设置提供了基本的风险保护
pros_en: The SuperTrend-based trend following strategy has clear logic and is suitable for trending markets
New bar detection mechanism prevents tick-level repeated trades, reducing overtrading risk
Independent buy/sell open and close permission controls provide high flexibility
Recount fault-tolerance mechanism automatically retries when data is insufficient
Fixed stop loss and take profit settings provide basic risk protection
cons: 完全依赖外部TradeAlgorithms.mqh库，缺少独立的交易逻辑实现，可移植性差
止损止盈使用固定点数而非ATR动态调整，在不同波动率市场下可能不适用
缺少滑点和点差过滤，在高点差环境下可能产生不利成交
没有持仓检查机制，可能在已有同方向持仓时重复开仓
指标句柄获取失败时仅打印警告但不终止初始化，可能导致后续交易逻辑异常
cons_en: Fully depends on external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library, lacking independent trading logic implementation and poor portability
Stop loss and take profit use fixed points instead of ATR-based dynamic adjustment, which may be unsuitable across different volatility environments
No spread or slippage filter, potentially resulting in unfavorable fills in high-spread conditions
No position check mechanism, may repeatedly open positions in the same direction
Indicator handle failure only prints a warning without terminating initialization, potentially causing abnormal subsequent trading logic
improvements: 增加ATR动态止损止盈功能，根据市场波动率自动调整止损止盈距离
添加持仓检查和同方向持仓数量限制，避免重复开仓导致过度集中风险
增加点差过滤和交易时段过滤，提高入场质量和避免低流动性时段交易
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop loss/take profit functionality that automatically adjusts distances based on market volatility
Add position checking and same-direction position count limits to avoid repeated opening and over-concentration risk
Add spread filter and trading session filter to improve entry quality and avoid trading during low liquidity periods

risk_points: 指标句柄初始化失败时EA不会停止运行，可能导致无信号状态下执行交易逻辑
缺少持仓检查机制，可能在同方向已有持仓时重复开仓增加风险敞口
固定止损止盈在不同市场波动率下可能过大或过小，无法适应市场变化
risk_points_en: EA continues running when indicator handle initialization fails, potentially executing trading logic without valid signals
Lack of position checking may cause repeated opening in the same direction, increasing risk exposure
Fixed stop loss/take profit may be too large or too small under different market volatility, unable to adapt to market changes
